rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Royal Order A/45 dated 29/2/1434 AH, issued by King Abdullah, constitutes the Shura Council of 'الرئيس معالي الشيخ الدكتور / عبدالله بن محمد بن إبراهيم آل الشيخ' and named members for four Hijri years beginning when the term of the current council, formed by A/15 of 19/2/1430 AH, ends.
